name: Reality Change
source:
Reality Change is about a lonely (and slightly wimpish) boy named Ryoichi Goto. His health is so bad he stopped going to school. After meeting a mysterious girl, Ryoichi starts having very realistic dreams about him having a normal life. But it is a dream at all?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=9487]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
